verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows the Guichet unique (inpi.fr / procedures.inpi.fr) serving a real robots.txt. The only robots.txt probe targets a different state service, the Annuaire des Entreprises, and returned HTTP 403, so it says nothing about INPI's own front door.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
